QI can be effective and sustainable if it is: 1) embedded within a system of care; 2) supported by the use of EHR data; 3) informed by the expertise of a range of partners; 4) focused on a specific condition; 5) driven by the needs of patients and clinicians; and 6) supported by the development of tools that allow automation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a collaborative QI programme can be achieved in a range of healthcare settings and is a sustainable method of improving the quality of care received by service-users.
the key to successful and sustained QI is the strategic involvement of all stakeholders, the use of data and the application of a range of tools to support the delivery of the QI process.
QI programmes that harness EHR data, and are supported by a range of partners, can be effective and efficient in the delivery of care for chronic diseases in a range of healthcare settings.
